title.zh: Circle与ACI Worldwide合作在拉美引入USDC结算
title.en: Circle partners with ACI Worldwide to bring USDC settlement to Latin America

current_state.zh: Circle is partnering with payments-technology firm ACI Worldwide to embed USDC settlement into existing bank payment rails in Latin America, starting with a Colombia pilot built on ACI's Bre-B instant-payments system and Connetic orchestration platform.
current_state.en: Circle is partnering with payments-technology firm ACI Worldwide to embed USDC settlement into existing bank payment rails in Latin America, starting with a Colombia pilot built on ACI's Bre-B instant-payments system and Connetic orchestration platform.
